title: Hanasato Minori — Smoothies Blended With Feelings〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: Chasing The Sparkle Beyond the Blue Sky

rows.Line: Beach

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Shizuku's going so fast! Even though she's blindfolded! I have to find a way to catch up to her!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And there's Haruka with an excellent save! Despite Shizuku rocketing off, Haruka managed to keep her away from that big bump in the sand!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Oh no! I was probably supposed to tell her about that.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But I finally managed to catch up to Shizuku and Haruka!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (And the watermelon... Wait, how'd it get over there?!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Shizuku! Left! Further left!
You'll end up in the water if you go that way!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay, going left!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh no! Shizuku, wait!
That isn't left! You're going backwards diagonally!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
What a turn of events!
Minori wanted Shizuku to move to her ten o'clock position but somehow ended up at her seven!!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And that's the best part about this activity! You never know what's gonna happen!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Geez, I laughed so hard that I spat out my tea!!>
<Shizuku did such a beautiful turn that I wasn't really sure what happened there for a second.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I knew Shizuku didn't have the best sense of direction, but I can see why she wasn't allowed to do this...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (What do I do now...?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Shizuku's faithfully doing everything Minori and I are telling her to do, but she's been moving further and further away from the watermelon...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (We need to get her moving back in the right direction...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(I... I have to get her back on track!
I need to move to the front and...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wh-Whoa...!
That was close...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Hmm... I'm having so much trouble running. My feet keep getting stuck in the sand. If only I had a strong core like Haruka or Shizuku...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Wait, there's no time for that right now! I have to keep running as best I can and keep up with the others.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Also, if I keep worrying about my footing, I won't be able to guide Shizuku to the watermelon...!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, it looks like Haruka's figured out how to guide Shizuku! She's gently leading Shizuku by the hand!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
It's like she's at the helm of a ship!
What an incredible sight...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Not only that, she's doing all this while making sure they maintain their speed! Talk about great support!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (She's right. Haruka's gently pushing and pulling against Shizuku while not getting in her way!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Wait, no...! I don't have time to admire her..! I should be guiding her!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But I'm having so much trouble running in this sand that I can't relay any information...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(What can I do...?
How can I help Haruka and Shizuku...?)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, ready?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm ready!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Shizuku, you're facing the sea.
The camera's this way!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, okay.
Thank you, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Yeah, that's it...!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thirty seconds left!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<They aren't gonna make it.>
<This is harder than I thought.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Shizuku, please slow down until I say otherwise!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Huh? Why?
<You want her to slow down? But you're running out of time.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Just waaaiiit!!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: M-Minori seems to have some kind of plan. She's sprinting towards the watermelon all by herself at full speed!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Shizuku! Haruka!
Over here!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Follow my voice!
I'll keep calling your names like this!!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Okay, I think I understand!
Haruka, I'm going to increase my speed.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Okay, got it.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Wh-Whoa!
Haruka and Shizuku are running at nearly full speed now! Straight towards the watermelon too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: They might just...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yay! We made it in less than three minutes!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: 2’ 56” to be exact! It was close, but your last-ditch plan made such a huge difference in the end, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, I never would've thought to run towards the watermelon and call for my teammates.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Me neither.
Thank you for guiding me like you promised, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, that was an incredible comeback.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You get a zero for entertainment value!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wh-Whaaat...?!
Wh-Why? Because we succeeded on our first attempt?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, I think it's because you fell out of the frame...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Exactly! Your amazing idea sort of went to waste because our only camera is this phone. You ran so far away that our viewers couldn't possibly have seen what happened.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It would've been much easier to film if you'd broken it up into two separate sprint sections instead of just the one.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I... I see...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're an idol, so you need to know where the cameras are! Got it?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes, ma'am!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Good answer!
Now, with that in mind, let's do our second attempt!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku & Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah!
